name: Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon 2027
short_description: A full marathon and half marathon event held on 9 May 2027 in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, organized by the Kinabalu Running Club.
ai_summary: The Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon 2027 is set for 9 May 2027 in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, organized by the Kinabalu Running Club. faqs.question: When does the Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon 2027 take place?
faqs.answer: The event is scheduled to take place on 9 May 2027. It is held in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, and is organized by the Kinabalu Running Club, offering both a full marathon and a half marathon distance for participants on that single race day.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose between two distances: a full marathon covering 42.195 kilometers, which serves as the primary distance, and a half marathon covering 21.1 kilometers. Both races are part of the same event weekend organized by the Kinabalu Running Club in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Can I still register for the 2027 race?
faqs.answer: No, registration for the Borneo International Marathon / Borneo Half Marathon 2027 is currently listed as sold out. This means all available spots for both the full marathon and half marathon distances have already been claimed ahead of the 9 May 2027 event date.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in the Likas Stadium area of Kota Kinabalu, in the state of Sabah, Malaysia. This venue serves as the base for both the full marathon and half marathon distances organized by the Kinabalu Running Club for the 2027 edition.
